concerns.text: metrics.schema.yaml REQUIRES a `breakpoint_estimate` field on every aggregated-metrics row, but no task describes computing a per-library-size/per-pruning-group breakpoint estimate for the aggregated metrics file. T008 writes a single global `breakpoint` to analysis_report.json; T010's verification ('aggregated metrics file validates against metrics.schema.yaml') cannot pass as written. Add the per-row breakpoint_estimate computation to T008/T010 or note the field's derivation.

The spec commits to 'a sensitivity analysis sweeping these values over a range of task counts' in addition to the pruning interval. T009 sweeps only pruning intervals {5, 10, 15}; no task sweeps task counts (e.g., pruning trigger after N tasks with N varied, or subset sizes). Add the task-count sweep to T009 or extend T008's granularity sweep to cover it.

The plan's project structure lists `tests/integration/test_full_run.py`, but no task creates an integration test. T003 covers contract tests and T006 unit tests only. Add a task (or extend T010) to implement the integration test verifying the full pipeline end-to-end.

plan.md's analysis phase reads `metrics.csv`, but no task produces that file — tasks write `data/results/experiment_log.csv` per experiment_log.schema.yaml. The plan element 'metrics.csv' has no implementing task; either a task must emit metrics.csv or the plan/tasks filenames must be reconciled so the analysis input path is unambiguous.
